source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned throne and plural peoples and retains the tent/dwelling connection.
key_decisions.before: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, “Look, the dwelling of God is with mankind. He will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them,
key_decisions.after: I heard a loud voice from the throne say: “Look, God's tent is with humanity. He will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, “Behold, the dwelling of God is with mankind. He will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them,

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the plural completed form and preserves the free gift and both title pairs.
key_decisions.before: And he said to me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will give from the spring of the water of life without payment.
key_decisions.after: He said to me, “These things are done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give freely from the spring of the water of life to anyone who thirsts.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will give from the spring of the water of life without payment.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the sonship/inheritance formula while using a generic singular recipient.
key_decisions.before: The one who conquers will inherit these things, and I will be his God and he will be my son.
key_decisions.after: The one who overcomes will inherit these things. I will be that person's God, and that person will be my son.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The one who conquers will inherit these things, and I will be his God and he will be my son.

subsequent_editorial_changes.previous_after: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be their God, and they will be my son.
subsequent_editorial_changes.rationale: Make the singular generic recipient explicit while preserving the scriptural sonship formula and the promised inheritance.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the enormous exact measure and three equal dimensions without choosing a symbolic interpretation.
key_decisions.before: The city lies foursquare, its length the same as its width. And he measured the city with his rod, 12,000 stadia. Its length and width and height are equal.
key_decisions.after: The city lay square, its length the same as its width. He measured the city with the reed: 12,000 stadia. Its length, width and height were equal.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The city lies foursquare, its length the same as its width. And he measured the city with his rod, 12,000 stadia. Its length and width and height are equal.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the exact measure and human/angel relation without supplying height or thickness.
key_decisions.before: He also measured its wall, 144 cubits by human measurement, which is also an angel’s measurement.
key_decisions.after: He measured its wall: 144 cubits, by human measure, which the angel was using.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He also measured its wall, 144 cubits by human measurement, which is also an angel’s measurement.
